title: CCC Math: A Structural Algebra for DBM-SI, Autonomous AI Coding, and Recursive Structural Intelligence
description:
CCC Math proposes a structural mathematical framework centered around the Common Concept Core (CCC). The framework studies how structural cores are extracted, matched, transformed, preserved, diffused, triggered, and recursively evolved across metric spaces, graphs, trajectories, programs, policies, and recursive intelligence systems.

This repository positions CCC Math as a candidate mathematical abstraction layer for Structural Intelligence, including DBM-SI, CGCCC, Policy Decision Systems, Trajectory Intelligence, Universal Typing/Naming, Recursive Structural Intelligence, and Autonomous AI Coding.

The release includes a DOI-level README, canonical figure pack, figure index, and release metadata for communicating the academic and engineering significance of CCC-centered Structural Intelligence.
